label: preparing
what: Likely a coordinated, undisclosed gathering in the great hall tomorrow at eighteen hundred, possibly a surprise celebration. Builder has installed lanterns and secured my attendance as a routine lighting inspection; neighbour independently requests the same time and place and offers to escort me. Baker's cheerful lights may be related, though baker's involvement is less certain. Secretary recorded the inspection openly and appears genuinely unaware of the tea arrangements; no clear evidence of knowing assistance.
